Business at the CRA rate: not available
MilO\'s widget is switched off. Turn it on in MilO, Settings.
The trip, Start and End, and business dollars at the CRA rate
To add it yourself: touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, then Widgets, then MilO.

The dollars are this month\'s and this year\'s Business kilometres at the CRA\'s per-kilometre rate (%1$d: %2$d¢ for the first 5,000 km of the year, %3$d¢ after). They are for reference only: the report for the accountant stays in kilometres. Switched off, the widget cannot be added, and one already on the home screen says so, or is removed by the home screen.
